lines.text: Cole stares down the barrel of a pistol held by his ruthless half-brother Jake inside the darkened study.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: You are willing to commit murder just to inherit the shipping empire, Jake.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: I am protecting my mother Diane, and you were always just a grease-monkey impostor, Cole.
Nurse Harper paces beside the bed of her 17-year-old sister Mia, whose left arm remains trapped in a restrictive medical sling.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Jake blackmailed me into transferring here, Mia, and now Cole is alone with him at the mansion.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: You have to call the police right now, Harper, before Jake hurts him.
Cole presses his bleeding side, his post-surgery bandages soaking through with fresh crimson blood onto the Persian rug.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Drop Evelyn's glass poison vial on the floor, Cole, or I pull this trigger right now.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: My grandmother Evelyn knew Diane was poisoning her, and I will never let you bury the truth.
The mahogany study door suddenly bursts open as police officers rush in with drawn weapons.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Drop your weapon, officer, my half-brother Cole just tried to murder me!
Cole looks in horror as the lead detective slaps heavy steel handcuffs onto his injured wrists.
